graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
FROM momentum-hunt backlog (kr-novel-momentum-hunt) Tier-A, highest feasibility (5). NON-return AND NON-flow (full axis change). FULL build-ready spec at stage_artifacts/momentum_hunt/backlog.json -> specs[name='Liquidity Improvement Momentum (Amihud trend, not level)']. READ IT and follow build_steps.

CONCEPT: Liquidity IMPROVEMENT momentum = negative slope of log-Amihud illiquidity over ~126d (Amihud computed on 20d windows). Signal fires when a stock's price-impact is TRENDING DOWN (liquidity improving). Pure OHLCV (rawdata Ret/Vol/Close) — no flow, no consensus. Mechanism: improving liquidity attracts liquidity-gated institutional/foreign/pension capital and front-runs index/ETF inclusion — economically real, slow-moving in KR. Distinct from L10/L29 (2-point Amihud ratios) via regression-slope over the path.

WHY NOW / FULL AXIS PIVOT: campaign so far — return-derived (FIP/Hurst/PCDM) and Foreign+Inst-flow-LEVEL (C21/C22) both NULL; OtherCorp (C23) produced a REAL orthogonal rank-IC (Harvey-t 3.38) but mid-decile so top-20 can't capture it (AX-007). Liquidity is a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT non-return axis (price-impact dynamics) — tests whether liquidity-trend carries TOP-concentrated edge. Cheapest/cleanest test (feasibility 5, pure OHLCV).

CRITICAL — learn from C23: report the DECILE CONCENTRATION explicitly. rank-IC alone is insufficient (C23 had Harvey-t 3.38 rank-IC but PORT_t -0.52 because the signal was mid-decile). Report D10-D9 gap and whether the edge is TOP-concentrated (top-20 long-only tradeable) vs mid-decile (screen-route only).

ORTHOGONALITY: prove vs L10/L29 (existing Amihud-level/ratio factors — slope-of-trend must be distinct, |corr|<0.5), M01, Size (small-cap liquidity bias check), L03/L28 volume momentum.

HONEST RISK (per spec + AX-000 amended): (1) liquidity improvement may already be priced (efficient) or coincide with momentum/size -> no incremental edge. (2) may be a top-concentration failure like C23 (real rank-IC, no port_t). Graduation NOT presumed; real-but-non-graduating -> screen-route. A clean negative is success; one data point, never a structural limit.

PIT/CONSTRAINTS: Amihud + slope from rawdata with Date<=sig_date ONLY (C1 rolling, no full-sample); volume t-1 (C10); cross-sectional z per sig_date; C13 Z_Score_Aligned; C14; C15. long-only ONLY; KR; max 25; [0,0.20]; 15bps; prod liquidity 2e8. real-computation (canonical_screen_bt) ONLY; Codex Critic Round mandatory. rawdata BM_Ret empty -> .cache/benchmark.parquet. R segfault guard.
